title: test_deposit rides the testing database, leaving live counts unchanged
intention: test_deposit.py rides the testing database: under the test runner every row it writes goes to cairn_testing (e4fd7f28faaf), never to the live tables, so a run leaves the live cairn_nodes, cairn_embeddings and cairn_links counts unchanged and two copies at once do not collide. The proof carries no run id, no testing marker and no clean-up of its own.
why: Measured 2026-11-20: 1712 nodes and 1712 embeddings from this proof's runs stand in the live cairn_nodes and cairn_embeddings, none marked as testing, because its scratch nexus drops only the leaf table. Proof rows in the live corpus are indistinguishable from real ones to every reader of the trees.
traces_to: Law 3 (nothing is known until measured: a proof's rows in the live corpus are measurements of nothing, read as real); Law 9 (green is earned: a proof that leaves residue is not clean green).
how: Rides e4fd7f28faaf: once a test run's writes reach cairn_testing by construction (outline 4.3.1.5.1.5.2, the runner sets the context, never the proof), cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_deposit.py needs no mark-and-clean code, and this ticket writes none. Its build is the red-first proof cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_deposit_runs_alongside_itself.py: it runs two copies of test_deposit.py at once and reads the live cairn_nodes, cairn_embeddings and cairn_links counts before and after. It is red today (the rows land in live) and turns green when e4fd7f28faaf lands, with no change to test_deposit.py. If it stays red after e4fd7f28faaf, what remains is this ticket's finding. RULE 1: it measures only codemother's own proof.

clauses.claim: two copies of test_deposit.py run at the same time, both exit 0 with no FAIL tooth

across a run of test_deposit.py, the live rows it could have written are unchanged, read from the live database: the cairn_nodes whose provenance names a chart_verdict_proof_ scratch dir, and the cairn_embeddings and cairn_links that join to those nodes by id; zero rows left in live. The live totals are reported and never asserted, because another live writer moves them
one copy of test_deposit.py run alone still exits 0

decisions.text: D1: no change to test_deposit.py: no run id, no testing marker, no finally-block cleanup. The isolation is e4fd7f28faaf's, by construction.
D2: the red-first proof runs two copies at once and counts rows before and after, one tooth per clause.

out: cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_deposit.py itself (it rides e4fd7f28faaf; no mark-and-clean code is written)
e4fd7f28faaf's store door (cairn/devices/db_domain), its own ticket
the 1712 rows already in the tables (not deleted or attributed here)

measured.saw: Read-only SELECT on the live cairn db (akiendelllinux): 1712 rows in cairn_nodes with provenance under a chart_verdict_proof_ scratch dir since 2026-10-03 (4901 in all; the verdict chart proof stopped depositing on 2026-10-02, b6a344e64, ticket e8fe361a5b2f, so the rows since are this proof's), latest 2026-11-13 18:16; 366 each of 'CONFIRMED: build the alpha splitter', 'KILLED: compose the settled machinery', 'the door refuses the phantom -> pass' and 'the splitter is green twice', 124 of 'VERDICT for ticket sworn'; the same count in cairn_embeddings; 0 of them carry any testing marker in provenance.
measured.how: SELECT count(*), max(created) FROM cairn_nodes / cairn_embeddings WHERE provenance LIKE '%chart_verdict_proof_%' (and by content prefix), on a read-only session; nothing run against live

measured.saw: cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_deposit.py deposits through trees.deposit (line 191), drain_pending (lines 225-393) and deposit_verdict (lines 442, 451) into its scratch nexi (verdict and verdict_named); trees.deposit writes the node to cairn_nodes and the embedding to cairn_embeddings, shared and live, and only the leaf to the scratch table. scratch_nexus drops only the leaf table at exit, and the proof never calls trees.forget_leaf.
